mapper.select: SELECT ad_account_asset_id FROM ad_account_asset_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY assigned_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, ad_account_asset_id, user_id, user_name, usage_team_name, is_primary, assignment_status, assignment_source, application_id, assigned_at, released_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM ad_account_asset_assignment WHERE ad_account_asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY assigned_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_account_asset_assignment ( ad_account_asset_id, user_id, user_name, usage_team_name, is_primary, assignment_status, assignment_source, application_id, assigned_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{adAccountAssetId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{usageTeamName}, #{isPrimary}, 'ACTIVE', #{assignmentSource}, #{applicationId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = VALUES(user_name), usage_team_name = VALUES(usage_team_name), is_primary = VALUES(is_primary), assignment_status = 'ACTIVE', assignment_source = VALUES(assignment_source), application_id = VALUES(application_id), released_at = NULL, updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
